paper_title: Quantifying Visual Change in Southern Song Woodblock Books through Regular Script Morphology
analysis_scope: Body-text regular-script macro morphology, not complete page layout.

metric_definitions.black_white_ratio: thresholded black pixels / (Lb^2 - thresholded black pixels); historically called ink_coverage in code

character_comparison: intersection of shared character identities within EACH stated comparison
aggregation: equal weight per book-character mean, then equal weight per book
dispersion: population standard deviation across distinct character identities after trimming

fixed_common_pool_region_comparison.description: For historical CHANGE IN regional contrast, hold shared characters fixed across both periods.

year_uncertainty.primary: year_nominal for matching legacy output; not a claim of precision

repeat_instance_policy: all confirmed; 70 book-character groups have 4–5 instances. deterministic cap3 is a sensitivity analysis.
published_unit: edition-level mean/dispersion of common character-level representatives
exclusions: No scanned pages, cropped character images, OCR boxes, review states or absolute paths in public dataset
